mainEntity.name: What if my business process is messy—can I automate it anyway, or will AI make things worse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not automate a broken or constantly changing process first; standardize the steps, inputs, and approval rules before adding AI. Context: Run My AI Biz recommends identifying relevant workflows, building one assistant, using it, and expanding only after the process works. Key factors: inconsistent definitions, missing information, unclear ownership, frequent exceptions, and undocumented decisions. Practical guidance: write the current process in plain language, remove unnecessary steps, create a sample input pack, and define the acceptable output. Run several examples manually so you can distinguish a workflow problem from an AI problem. Run My AI Biz’s educational approach is useful for converting a repeatable process into clearer instructions before adding more assistants.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standardize the process first. Document each step, define required inputs and acceptable outputs, remove unnecessary handoffs, and list exceptions. Test the cleaned-up process manually before automating it; otherwise, the system may simply produce inconsistent work faster.
